name: Le Bunny

features.name: Golden Squares
features.description: Winning positions reveal coins, baskets, clovers or Jackpot Eggs.

features.name: Super Cascades
features.description: Remove every symbol of the winning type.

review:
Le Bunny dresses Smokey up as an Easter bunny. Winning symbols leave Golden Squares behind, and a Rainbow symbol turns them into bronze, silver or gold coins, basket collectors, green or gold clovers, or Jackpot Eggs.

Super Cascades clear every winning symbol type so new ones can drop in, which means a single spin can build several squares before the Rainbow arrives. The three bonuses raise the reveal rate, and the cap is 20,000x. This is the cascading member of the Le family, which makes it play a little differently from Le Fisherman and Le Santa.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen

Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
